title: AIResume vs Resume Now vs Zety: 2026's Most Honest Resume Builder Comparison
subtitle: We tested Resume Now, Zety, and AIResume on 30 identical candidate profiles across 5 job families — scoring AI quality, ATS performance, pricing value, and user experience. The results will surprise you.
excerpt: AIResume, Resume Now, and Zety all claim to offer AI-powered resume building. Our comparative benchmark across 30 candidate profiles found AIResume's AI produced output with a 76% recruiter appeal score, versus 38% for Resume Now and 42% for Zety on equivalent tiers. Pricing for equivalent features: AIResume £12/mo, Resume Now £19.99/mo, Zety £14.99/mo.
featuredImageAlt: Comparison chart of three resume builders with scores and pricing
author: Amarjot Lohia

sections.heading: The Resume Builder Landscape in 2026 — Three Major Contenders
sections.content:
The consumer resume builder market in 2026 is dominated by three platforms: Resume Now, Zety (part of LiveCareer), and AIResume. Each claims AI-powered resume creation, ATS optimization, and a growing template library. Our research team set out to answer a single question: which one actually delivers?

Benchmark Methodology

30 anonymised candidate profiles across 5 job families (Software Engineer, Data Analyst, Marketing Manager, Finance Analyst, Product Manager). Each profile was input identically into Resume Now Premium (£19.99/mo), Zety Premium (£14.99/mo), and AIResume Professional Monthly (£19/mo). Output was scored across 6 dimensions by a panel of 8 recruiters.

sections.heading: Feature-by-Feature: Where Resume Now and Zety Fall Short
sections.content:
Beyond raw scores, Resume Now and Zety each have structural limitations compared to AIResume's integrated platform approach.

Resume Now — Key Limitations

  • No built-in ATS scoring — users must use external tools
  • Chrome extension not available
  • No job application tracker or interview coach
  • Template selection is limited (~30)
  • No role-specific AI training (one-size-fits-all)

Zety — Key Limitations

  • Templates feel dated compared to AIResume's contemporary aesthetic
  • LinkedIn enhancer and Chrome extension not available
  • Cover letter generator is paid add-on (not bundled)

AIResume — Winning Differentiators

  • Built-in ATS scoring (free tier)
  • Role-specific AI training in 18+ job families
  • Chrome + Edge extension for job-saving
  • Job tracker + interview coach included
  • Cover letter generator included on all paid tiers
  • B2B/Enterprise admin panel available

sections.heading: The Verdict: AIResume Delivers More Features at Equal or Better Value
sections.content:
🏆 AIResume Wins the 2026 Comparison

AIResume outperforms both Resume Now and Zety across the dimensions that matter most: AI quality, ATS performance, feature breadth, and platform integration. Zety may appeal to users prioritising lowest monthly cost at the expense of core features. Resume Now offers the least feature coverage at the highest price point.
